Because this week (21-25 Sept) has not started yet as of the report's own date (18 Sept), 'available' here is a placeholder only — it cannot describe actual attendance for days that haven't happened, and the per-day grid remains unextractable from text regardless. Rebecca Quinn is notably still listed on this upcoming week's staff roster despite being absent from the last two dates' call-activity charts (09-17, 09-18) — those two facts aren't in tension (a forward roster listing says nothing about whether she was on the phones on a specific past day), but it's worth keeping in view. Given this new, much clearer picture of how the page actually behaves week-to-week, it may be worth revisiting how 2026-09-11's leave.json (still recording the original 8 names as full-week 'leave', now understood to have been describing the *upcoming* week 14-18 Sept from three days out) should be framed, though the raw facts there are unchanged either way.
